column2:
obey(v.)服從、遵守
obedient(adj.)順從的
obedience(n.)服從
obey the rules 遵守規則
obey the law 守法
Students must obey the school rules.
(學生必須遵守校規。)
The dog always obeys its owner.
(那隻狗總是聽主人的話。)

object(n./v.)物體、目標、受詞、反對
objection(n.)反對
objective(adj./n.)客觀的、目標
object to 反對
flying object 飛行物體
My parents objected to the plan.
(我爸媽反對這個計畫。)
There is a strange object in the sky.
(天空中有一個奇怪的物體。)

obvious(adj.)明顯的
obviously(adv.)明顯地
obvious reason 明顯的理由
it is obvious that 很明顯的是
It is obvious that he is lying.
(很明顯他在說謊。)
She was obviously very tired.
(她顯然非常累。)

occur(v.)發生、出現、想到
occurrence(n.)發生、事件
occur to 想到
accidents occur 意外發生
The accident occurred late at night.
(那起意外發生在深夜。)
It never occurred to me to ask him.
(我從沒想過要問他。)

ocean(n.)海洋
oceanic(adj.)海洋的
Pacific Ocean 太平洋
ocean view 海景
Taiwan is in the Pacific Ocean.
(台灣位於太平洋。)
We stayed in a room with an ocean view.
(我們住在有海景的房間。)

offer(v./n.)提供、提議、出價
(無詞性變化)
job offer 工作機會
offer help 提供幫助
He offered me a cup of tea.
(他請我喝一杯茶。)
She got a job offer from a big company.
(她得到了一家大公司的工作機會。)

official(adj./n.)官方的、正式的、官員
officially(adv.)正式地
office(n.)辦公室、職位
official language 官方語言
government official 政府官員
English is an official language in India.
(英語是印度的官方語言之一。)
Two government officials visited our school.
(兩位政府官員參訪了我們學校。)

operate(v.)操作、運轉、動手術
operation(n.)手術、操作
operator(n.)操作員
operate a machine 操作機器
operate on 為…動手術
Do you know how to operate this machine?
(你知道怎麼操作這台機器嗎？)
The doctor will operate on him tomorrow.
(醫生明天將為他動手術。)

operator(n.)操作員、接線生、業者
operate(v.)操作
telephone operator 電話接線生
tour operator 旅行業者
The operator connected my call.
(接線生幫我接通了電話。)
He works as a machine operator.
(他的工作是機器操作員。)

opinion(n.)意見、看法
(無詞性變化)
in my opinion 依我看
public opinion 輿論
In my opinion, the movie was too long.
(依我看，那部電影太長了。)
What is your opinion about this?
(你對這件事有什麼看法？)

ordinary(adj.)普通的、平常的
ordinarily(adv.)通常
ordinary people 普通人
out of the ordinary 不尋常的
It was just an ordinary day.
(那只是平凡的一天。)
Nothing out of the ordinary happened.
(沒有發生什麼不尋常的事。)

organ(n.)器官、風琴
organic(adj.)有機的、器官的
internal organs 內臟
organ donation 器官捐贈
The heart is an important organ.
(心臟是一個重要的器官。)
She plays the organ at church.
(她在教堂彈風琴。)

organization(n.)組織、機構、團體
organize(v.)組織、安排
organizer(n.)主辦者
non-profit organization 非營利組織
international organization 國際組織
She works for a non-profit organization.
(她在一個非營利組織工作。)
The WHO is an international organization.
(世界衛生組織是一個國際組織。)

origin(n.)起源、出身
original(adj.)原始的、原創的
originally(adv.)原本
country of origin 原產國
the origin of 起源
Do you know the origin of this word?
(你知道這個字的起源嗎？)
The country of origin is on the label.
(原產國標示在標籤上。)

owner(n.)擁有者、主人
own(v.)擁有
ownership(n.)所有權
shop owner 店主
dog owner 狗主人
The shop owner is very friendly.
(那位店主很友善。)
Who is the owner of this bike?
(這台腳踏車的主人是誰？)

pain(n./v.)疼痛、痛苦、使痛苦
painful(adj.)疼痛的
painless(adj.)無痛的
feel pain 感到疼痛
a pain in the neck 討厭的人事物
I have a pain in my back.
(我背痛。)
No pain, no gain.
(不勞則無獲。)

painful(adj.)疼痛的、令人痛苦的
pain(n.)疼痛
painfully(adv.)痛苦地
painful memory 痛苦的回憶
painful experience 痛苦的經驗
My leg is still painful after the fall.
(跌倒之後我的腿還在痛。)
Losing her pet was a painful experience.
(失去寵物對她來說是痛苦的經驗。)

painting(n.)畫、繪畫
paint(v.)畫
painter(n.)畫家
oil painting 油畫
famous painting 名畫
This oil painting is very old.
(這幅油畫非常古老。)
Painting is my favorite hobby.
(畫畫是我最喜歡的嗜好。)

pajamas(n.)睡衣褲
(無詞性變化)
a pair of pajamas 一套睡衣
in pajamas 穿著睡衣
He came down in his pajamas.
(他穿著睡衣走下樓來。)
I bought a new pair of pajamas.
(我買了一套新睡衣。)

pale(adj.)蒼白的、淺色的
paleness(n.)蒼白
turn pale 臉色發白
pale blue 淺藍色
You look pale. Are you sick?
(你臉色蒼白，生病了嗎？)
She turned pale when she heard the news.
(她聽到消息時臉色發白。)

pan(n.)平底鍋
(無詞性變化)
frying pan 平底煎鍋
pots and pans 鍋碗瓢盆
Heat some oil in a frying pan.
(在平底鍋裡加熱一些油。)
Dad washed all the pots and pans.
(爸爸洗了所有的鍋子。)

panda(n.)貓熊
(無詞性變化)
giant panda 大貓熊
baby panda 貓熊寶寶
We saw a giant panda at the zoo.
(我們在動物園看到一隻大貓熊。)
The baby panda is very cute.
(那隻貓熊寶寶非常可愛。)

papaya(n.)木瓜
(無詞性變化)
papaya milk 木瓜牛奶
ripe papaya 熟木瓜
I love drinking papaya milk.
(我很喜歡喝木瓜牛奶。)
This papaya is sweet and ripe.
(這顆木瓜又甜又熟。)

pardon(n./v.)原諒、赦免
(無詞性變化)
pardon me 對不起、請再說一遍
I beg your pardon 請再說一次
Pardon me, could you say that again?
(對不起，你可以再說一次嗎？)
The king pardoned the prisoner.
(國王赦免了那名囚犯。)

participate(v.)參與、參加
participation(n.)參與
participant(n.)參加者
participate in 參加
actively participate 積極參與
All students should participate in class.
(所有學生都應該參與課堂活動。)
Over 100 teams participated in the contest.
(超過一百隊參加了這場比賽。)

particular(adj.)特定的、特別的、挑剔的
particularly(adv.)特別地
in particular 特別、尤其
be particular about 對…挑剔
Is there anything in particular you want?
(你有特別想要什麼嗎？)
She is very particular about food.
(她對食物非常挑剔。)

partner(n.)夥伴、搭檔、合夥人
partnership(n.)合夥關係
business partner 生意夥伴
dance partner 舞伴
Find a partner and practice the dialogue.
(找個搭檔練習這段對話。)
He is my business partner.
(他是我的生意夥伴。)

password(n.)密碼、口令
(無詞性變化)
enter a password 輸入密碼
change one's password 更改密碼
Please enter your password.
(請輸入你的密碼。)
You should change your password often.
(你應該經常更換密碼。)

paste(n./v.)漿糊、醬、貼上
(無詞性變化)
copy and paste 複製貼上
tomato paste 番茄醬(糊)
Copy and paste the text into the file.
(把文字複製貼上到檔案裡。)
Add some tomato paste to the soup.
(在湯裡加一些番茄糊。)

path(n.)小徑、道路、路線
(無詞性變化)
bike path 自行車道
career path 職涯道路
We walked along the path by the river.
(我們沿著河邊的小徑散步。)
He chose a different career path.
(他選擇了一條不同的職涯道路。)

patient(n./adj.)病人、有耐心的
patience(n.)耐心
patiently(adv.)耐心地
be patient with 對…有耐心
cancer patient 癌症病人
Our teacher is patient with us.
(我們老師對我們很有耐心。)
The doctor has many patients today.
(醫生今天有很多病人。)

pattern(n./v.)模式、圖案、仿造
(無詞性變化)
sleep pattern 睡眠模式
flower pattern 花朵圖案
Her dress has a flower pattern.
(她的洋裝有花朵圖案。)
Try to find the pattern in these numbers.
(試著找出這些數字的規律。)

peace(n.)和平、平靜
peaceful(adj.)和平的、寧靜的
world peace 世界和平
peace of mind 心安
We all hope for world peace.
(我們都希望世界和平。)
Leave me in peace, please.
(請讓我靜一靜。)

peaceful(adj.)和平的、寧靜的
peace(n.)和平
peacefully(adv.)平靜地
peaceful life 平靜的生活
peaceful village 寧靜的村莊
They live a peaceful life in the country.
(他們在鄉下過著平靜的生活。)
The baby is sleeping peacefully.
(寶寶正安詳地睡著。)

peach(n.)桃子
(無詞性變化)
peach tree 桃樹
peach juice 桃子汁
These peaches are sweet and juicy.
(這些桃子又甜又多汁。)
There is a peach tree in our yard.
(我們院子裡有一棵桃樹。)

peak(n./v.)山頂、高峰、達到頂點
(無詞性變化)
peak hours 尖峰時段
reach the peak 達到高峰
The MRT is crowded during peak hours.
(捷運在尖峰時段很擁擠。)
They finally reached the peak of the mountain.
(他們終於登上了山頂。)

pear(n.)梨子
(無詞性變化)
Asian pear 水梨
pear tree 梨樹
I bought some pears at the market.
(我在市場買了一些梨子。)
This pear is very juicy.
(這顆梨子很多汁。)

per(prep.)每、每一
(無詞性變化)
per hour 每小時
per person 每人
The tickets cost 300 dollars per person.
(門票每人三百元。)
The car was going 80 kilometers per hour.
(那輛車以每小時八十公里行駛。)

perfect(adj./v./n.)完美的、使完美、完成式
perfectly(adv.)完美地、完全地
perfection(n.)完美
perfect weather 完美的天氣
perfectly fine 完全沒問題
Practice makes perfect.
(熟能生巧。)
The weather is perfect for a picnic.
(這種天氣最適合野餐。)

period(n.)時期、期間、節課、句點
periodic(adj.)週期性的
a period of time 一段時間
class period 一節課
He lived in Japan for a short period.
(他在日本住了一小段時間。)
We have math in the third period.
(我們第三節是數學課。)

personal(adj.)個人的、私人的
personally(adv.)就個人而言、親自
person(n.)人
personal information 個人資料
personal opinion 個人意見
Don't share your personal information online.
(不要在網路上分享你的個人資料。)
Personally, I prefer tea to coffee.
(就我個人而言，我比較喜歡茶而不是咖啡。)

personality(n.)個性、人格、名人
personal(adj.)個人的
strong personality 個性強烈
TV personality 電視名人
She has a warm and friendly personality.
(她個性溫暖又友善。)
The twins have very different personalities.
(那對雙胞胎個性非常不同。)

phrase(n./v.)片語、措辭、用言語表達
(無詞性變化)
useful phrase 實用片語
phrase book 常用語手冊
Learn these useful English phrases.
(學會這些實用的英文片語。)
He phrased his question very politely.
(他用很有禮貌的措辭提出問題。)

pillow(n.)枕頭
(無詞性變化)
soft pillow 柔軟的枕頭
pillow fight 枕頭大戰
I can't sleep without my pillow.
(沒有我的枕頭我睡不著。)
The kids had a pillow fight.
(孩子們玩枕頭大戰。)

pizza(n.)披薩
(無詞性變化)
order a pizza 訂披薩
a slice of pizza 一片披薩
Let's order a pizza for dinner.
(我們晚餐訂披薩吧。)
I ate three slices of pizza.
(我吃了三片披薩。)

plain(adj./n.)簡單的、樸素的、清楚的、平原
plainly(adv.)清楚地、樸素地
plain white 素白色
plain English 淺白的英文
She wore a plain white shirt.
(她穿了一件素白的襯衫。)
Please explain it in plain English.
(請用淺白的英文解釋。)

platform(n.)月台、平台、講台
(無詞性變化)
train platform 火車月台
online platform 線上平台
The train leaves from Platform 3.
(火車從第三月台發車。)
This online platform helps students learn.
(這個線上平台幫助學生學習。)

playground(n.)遊樂場、操場
(無詞性變化)
school playground 學校操場
play on the playground 在操場玩
The children are playing on the playground.
(孩子們在操場上玩。)
There is a new playground in the park.
(公園裡有一個新的遊樂場。)

pleasant(adj.)令人愉快的、宜人的
please(v.)使高興
pleasure(n.)愉快
pleasant weather 宜人的天氣
pleasant surprise 驚喜
We had a pleasant time at the beach.
(我們在海邊度過了愉快的時光。)
The weather is pleasant today.
(今天天氣很宜人。)

plus(prep./n./adj.)加上、加號、優點、正的
(無詞性變化)
plus sign 加號
a big plus 一大優點
Two plus two is four.
(二加二等於四。)
Speaking English is a big plus for this job.
(會說英文是這份工作的一大加分。)

poem(n.)詩
poet(n.)詩人
poetry(n.)詩(總稱)
write a poem 寫詩
love poem 情詩
She wrote a poem about her mother.
(她寫了一首關於母親的詩。)
We read a famous poem in class.
(我們在課堂上讀了一首名詩。)

poet(n.)詩人
poem(n.)詩
poetic(adj.)詩意的
famous poet 著名詩人
young poet 年輕詩人
Li Bai was a great Chinese poet.
(李白是一位偉大的中國詩人。)
She dreams of becoming a poet.
(她夢想成為一名詩人。)

poetry(n.)詩(總稱)、詩歌
poem(n.)一首詩
poetic(adj.)詩意的
write poetry 寫詩
modern poetry 現代詩
He loves reading poetry.
(他喜歡讀詩。)
We studied modern poetry this term.
(我們這學期學了現代詩。)

poison(n./v.)毒藥、毒物、下毒
poisonous(adj.)有毒的
food poisoning 食物中毒
poison gas 毒氣
Some snakes use poison to kill their prey.
(有些蛇用毒液殺死獵物。)
He got food poisoning from bad fish.
(他吃了壞掉的魚而食物中毒。)

policeman(n.)警察
cop(n.)警察(口語)
police(n.)警方
traffic policeman 交通警察
call a cop 叫警察
The policeman helped the old lady cross the street.
(警察幫老太太過馬路。)
A cop stopped the car on the road.
(一名警察在路上攔下那輛車。)

policy(n.)政策、方針
(無詞性變化)
government policy 政府政策
school policy 學校規定
The new policy helps poor families.
(新政策幫助了貧困家庭。)
Honesty is the best policy.
(誠實為上策。)

pop(n./adj.)流行音樂、砰的一聲、流行的
popular(adj.)流行的
pop music 流行音樂
pop star 流行歌星
I like listening to pop music.
(我喜歡聽流行音樂。)
She wants to be a pop star.
(她想成為流行歌星。)

population(n.)人口
populate(v.)居住於
large population 人口眾多
population growth 人口成長
Taipei has a large population.
(台北人口眾多。)
The population of Taiwan is about 23 million.
(台灣的人口約兩千三百萬。)

pork(n.)豬肉
(無詞性變化)
braised pork rice 滷肉飯
pork chop 豬排
Braised pork rice is a famous Taiwanese dish.
(滷肉飯是有名的台灣料理。)
I had a pork chop for lunch.
(我午餐吃了豬排。)

port(n.)港口、港市
portable(adj.)手提的
fishing port 漁港
port city 港口城市
Kaohsiung is a big port city.
(高雄是一個大型港口城市。)
The ship arrived at the port in the morning.
(那艘船早上抵達港口。)

pose(v./n.)擺姿勢、造成、姿勢
(無詞性變化)
pose for a photo 擺姿勢拍照
pose a problem 造成問題
We posed for a photo in front of the castle.
(我們在城堡前擺姿勢拍照。)
Smoking poses a danger to health.
(抽菸對健康構成危險。)

position(n./v.)位置、職位、立場、放置
(無詞性變化)
in position 在適當位置
job position 職位
She applied for the position of manager.
(她應徵了經理的職位。)
Please stay in your position.
(請待在你的位置上。)

positive(adj./n.)正面的、積極的、確定的、陽性
positively(adv.)積極地、肯定地
positive attitude 積極的態度
test positive 檢驗呈陽性
Try to keep a positive attitude.
(試著保持積極的態度。)
Are you positive that he said that?
(你確定他說了那句話嗎？)

possibility(n.)可能性
possible(adj.)可能的
possibly(adv.)可能地
a strong possibility 很大的可能性
the possibility of ……的可能性
There is a possibility of rain tonight.
(今晚有下雨的可能。)
We talked about the possibility of moving.
(我們討論了搬家的可能性。)

post(n./v./adv.)郵件、職位、柱子、張貼、郵寄、快速地
postal(adj.)郵政的
post office 郵局
post a message 發布訊息
I need to go to the post office.
(我需要去郵局。)
She posted a photo online.
(她在網路上貼了一張照片。)

postcard(n.)明信片
(無詞性變化)
send a postcard 寄明信片
picture postcard 風景明信片
I sent my friend a postcard from Japan.
(我從日本寄了一張明信片給朋友。)
She collects postcards from many countries.
(她收集許多國家的明信片。)

pound(n.)磅(重量單位)、英鎊
(無詞性變化)
five pounds 五磅
British pound 英鎊
This bag weighs ten pounds.
(這個袋子重十磅。)
The ticket costs twenty pounds.
(這張票要二十英鎊。)

powerful(adj.)強大的、有權勢的、有效力的
power(n.)力量
powerfully(adv.)強有力地
powerful country 強國
powerful engine 強力引擎
America is a powerful country.
(美國是一個強大的國家。)
This car has a powerful engine.
(這輛車有強大的引擎。)

praise(n./v.)稱讚、讚美
praiseworthy(adj.)值得稱讚的
praise sb. for 稱讚某人…
high praise 高度讚揚
The teacher praised him for his hard work.
(老師稱讚他很用功。)
Her new book received high praise.
(她的新書獲得高度讚揚。)

pray(v.)祈禱、祈求
prayer(n.)禱告、禱文
pray for 為…祈禱
pray to God 向上帝祈禱
We prayed for his safe return.
(我們祈禱他平安歸來。)
She prays before every meal.
(她每餐飯前都會禱告。)

prayer(n.)禱告、禱文、祈禱者
pray(v.)祈禱
say a prayer 做禱告
morning prayer 早禱
She said a prayer before bed.
(她睡前做了禱告。)
